wyr.q1: Would you rather never be able to lie again or never be able to keep a secret?
wyr.q1a: Never be able to lie again
wyr.q1b: Never be able to keep a secret
wyr.q2: Would you rather relive your first date forever or never have an argument?
wyr.q3: Would you rather your partner read all your thoughts for a day or meet all your exes?
wyr.q3a: They read all my thoughts for a day
wyr.q4: Would you rather always be right in arguments or never go to bed angry?
wyr.q5: Would you rather live in a small city apartment with your partner or in a big house in the countryside without them during the week?
wyr.q5b: A big house in the countryside without them during the week
wyr.q6: Would you rather your partner cook every meal (even if it's mediocre) or eat out every night (but never have a home-cooked meal)?
wyr.q6a: They cook every meal (even if it's mediocre)
wyr.q6b: Eat out every night (but never a home-cooked meal)
wyr.q7: Would you rather receive a long love letter every day or a single 10-minute cuddle every evening?
wyr.q7a: A long love letter every day
wyr.q8: Would you rather know the exact date of your breakup (if it happens) or never know?
wyr.q9: Would you rather your partner be very jealous but extremely caring or completely indifferent but super chill?
wyr.q10: Would you rather lose all your couple photos or lose all your messages to each other?
wyr.q10b: Lose all our messages to each other
wyr.q11: Would you rather have a perfect but boring relationship or an imperfect but passionate one?
wyr.q12: Would you rather never be able to say "I love you" but show it or say it 100 times a day but never show it?
wyr.q12a: Never say it but show it
wyr.q12b: Say it 100 times a day but never show it
wyr.q13: Would you rather your partner become famous and travel all the time or stay unknown but always be around?
wyr.q14: Would you rather have a partner who's always right or a partner who always makes you laugh?
wyr.q14b: A partner who always makes me laugh
wyr.q15: Would you rather relive your best memory together or erase your worst argument?
wyr.q16: Would you rather your partner plan everything in your life or never plan anything and improvise everything?
wyr.q16a: They plan everything in our life
wyr.q16b: Never plan anything and improvise everything
wyr.q17: Would you rather have to dance together in public every time you enter a store or sing a love song to each other at restaurants?
wyr.q17a: Dance together every time we enter a store
wyr.q17b: Sing a love song to each other at restaurants
wyr.q18: Would you rather only communicate by text for a week or only communicate by whispering for a month?
wyr.q18a: Only by text for a week
wyr.q18b: Only by whispering for a month
wyr.q19: Would you rather your partner be brutally honest even when it hurts or always soften the truth to spare your feelings?
wyr.q19a: Brutally honest even when it hurts
wyr.q20: Would you rather move abroad together to an unknown country or stay in the same place your whole life?
wyr.q20a: Move abroad to an unknown country
wyr.q20b: Stay in the same place our whole life
wyr.q21: Would you rather swap bodies with your partner for 24 hours or read their mind for 1 hour?
wyr.q22: Would you rather have lots of money but little time together or little money but all the free time in the world?
wyr.q22a: Lots of money but little time together
wyr.q22b: Little money but all the free time in the world
wyr.q23: Would you rather your partner have the same job as you or a completely different one?
wyr.q24: Would you rather grow old but never lose your bond or stay young but with a relationship that fades?
wyr.q24a: Grow old but never lose our bond
wyr.q24b: Stay young but with a relationship that fades
wyr.q25: Would you rather never be able to give gifts or never receive them?
wyr.q25a: Never be able to give gifts
wyr.q26: Would you rather have a partner who snores loudly but gives the best cuddles or a silent sleeper who stays on their side?
wyr.q26a: Snores loudly but gives the best cuddles
wyr.q26b: Silent sleeper who stays on their side
wyr.q27: Would you rather your partner be better than you at everything or you be better than them at everything?
wyr.q27a: They're better than me at everything
wyr.q27b: I'm better than them at everything
wyr.q28: Would you rather your families not get along at all or your friends not stand each other?
wyr.q28b: Our friends don't stand each other
wyr.q29: Would you rather have a very ambitious partner who's often away or a very present partner with no big ambitions?
wyr.q29b: Very present but no big ambitions
wyr.q30: Would you rather know what your partner truly thinks of you or keep some mystery?
wyr.q30a: Know what they truly think of me
wyr.q31: Would you rather be able to go through their phone whenever you want, or have them go through yours?
wyr.q31a: Go through theirs whenever I want
wyr.q32: Would you rather do the washing-up every night for ten years, or never pick the film again?
wyr.q32a: The washing-up every night for ten years
wyr.q33: Would you rather have a huge bed with a side each, or a single bed pressed together all night?
wyr.q33a: A huge bed, a side each
wyr.q33b: A single bed, pressed together all night
wyr.q34: Would you rather they leave their stuff everywhere, or tidy yours away without telling you?
wyr.q34b: They tidy my things away without telling me
wyr.q35: Would you rather wake up together at 6am every morning, or go to bed together at 3am every night?
wyr.q36: Would you rather never watch a series without them again, or be allowed a three-episode head start?
wyr.q37: Would you rather share one bathroom for life, or have separate flats in the same building?
wyr.q37a: One bathroom for the two of us
wyr.q37b: Two flats in the same building
wyr.q38: Would you rather they sing off-key in the shower every morning, or talk in their sleep every night?
wyr.q39: Would you rather always be the one driving, or never drive again?
wyr.q40: Would you rather have a cat that hates your partner, or a dog that likes you better than them?
wyr.q41: Would you rather share one account where everything shows, or keep two where neither of you knows a thing?
wyr.q42: Would you rather earn twice what they earn, or half?
wyr.q43: Would you rather inherit a house they hate, or rent for life somewhere you both love?
wyr.q44: Would you rather they spend without ever counting, or count every last penny?
wyr.q45: Would you rather have a dream holiday every five years, or a weekend away together every month?
wyr.q45a: A dream holiday every five years
wyr.q46: Would you rather live next door to their family, or a thousand miles from your own?
wyr.q47: Would you rather their mother rang you every single day, or never spoke to you at all?
wyr.q48: Would you rather spend every Christmas at their parents', or every summer holiday with them?
wyr.q49: Would you rather your best friend couldn't stand your partner, or the other way round?
wyr.q49a: My best friend can't stand them
wyr.q49b: They can't stand my best friend
wyr.q50: Would you rather move for their job, or have them turn down their dream job to stay?
wyr.q50b: They turn down their dream job
wyr.q51: Would you rather get a letter from them once a month, or hear "I love you" three times a day?
wyr.q51b: "I love you" three times a day
wyr.q52: Would you rather be proposed to in front of 200 people, or at 6am with nobody watching?
wyr.q53: Would you rather have a 30-guest wedding tomorrow, or a 200-guest wedding in three years?
wyr.q54: Would you rather they forget your anniversary completely, or remember it and do nothing?
wyr.q55: Would you rather fall in love at first sight, or after ten years of friendship?
wyr.q56: Would you rather they surprise you every day, or be predictable but never once let you down?
wyr.q57: Would you rather start your story again from scratch, or jump straight ten years ahead?
wyr.q58: Would you rather know exactly how many exes they've had, or what those exes still think of them?
wyr.q59: Would you rather they stayed friends with every ex, or cut ties with their whole past?
wyr.q59b: Ties cut with their whole past
wyr.q60: Would you rather run into their ex at every family meal, or yours at every night out?
wyr.q60a: Their ex at every family meal
wyr.q60b: My ex at every night out
wyr.q61: Would you rather they got jealous of your colleagues, or of your childhood friends?
wyr.q62: Would you rather they lied to you once about something enormous, or a hundred times about small things?
wyr.q62b: A hundred times, about small things
wyr.q63: Would you rather they completely change their look without warning you, or keep exactly the same one for twenty years?
wyr.q63b: The same look for twenty years
wyr.q64: Would you rather never kiss in public again, or never cuddle on the sofa again?
wyr.q64b: No more cuddling on the sofa
wyr.q65: Would you rather get an hour-long massage every Sunday, or breakfast in bed every Saturday?
wyr.q66: Would you rather your partner had a cartoon voice, or walked in slow motion for life?
wyr.q67: Would you rather they always smelled of candyfloss, or glowed in the dark?
wyr.q68: Would you rather the two of you had the same haircut for life, or the same outfit every day?
wyr.q69: Would you rather your song as a couple was a supermarket jingle, or a cartoon theme tune?
wyr.q70: Would you rather sneeze every time they kiss you, or hiccup every time you say "I love you"?
wyr.q71: Would you rather settle your arguments with rock-paper-scissors, or a coin toss?
wyr.q72: Would you rather they were followed by a brass band everywhere they went, or talked about themselves in the third person?
wyr.q72a: A brass band everywhere they go
wyr.q72b: Talking about themselves in the third person
wyr.q73: Would you rather take a three-week road trip with no plan at all, or three weeks in an all-inclusive hotel?
wyr.q73a: A road trip with no plan at all
wyr.q74: Would you rather miss a flight together, or each catch yours separately?
wyr.q75: Would you rather they picked every single destination, or never gave an opinion?
wyr.q76: Would you rather have a child with your temperament, or theirs?
wyr.q77: Would you rather have four children and no peace, or no children and a lot of silence?
wyr.q77b: No children, a lot of silence
wyr.q78: Would you rather they were the parent who always says yes, or the one who always says no?
wyr.q78a: The parent who always says yes
wyr.q78b: The one who always says no
wyr.q79: Would you rather grow old in a house full of grandchildren, or in a van, just the two of you, on the road?
wyr.q79b: A van on the road, just us two
wyr.q80: Would you rather they slam the door and come back ten minutes later, or stay and say nothing for two days?
wyr.q80a: They slam the door and come back
wyr.q80b: They stay and say nothing for two days
wyr.q81: Would you rather be right and prove it, or be wrong and have them never find out?
wyr.q82: Would you rather they tell you straight away what's wrong, or take three days to find the right words?
wyr.q82b: Three days to find the right words
wyr.q83: Would you rather argue often but make up quickly, or almost never but explosively?
wyr.q83a: Often, but quick to make up
wyr.q84: Would you rather they always apologise first even when they're right, or always be the one apologising yourself?
wyr.q85: Would you rather they post every moment of your relationship, or never post a single photo of you?
wyr.q86: Would you rather they reply to your messages in three seconds, or in three hours but with something real to say?
wyr.q86b: Three hours, but a real message
wyr.q87: Would you rather get a five-minute voice note every day, or one-word replies?
wyr.q88: Would you rather never call each other again, or never text each other again?
wyr.q89: Would you rather be loved for what you show, or for what you hide?
wyr.q90: Would you rather they stayed out of love but bored, or left and were happy?
wyr.q90a: They stay out of love but bored
wyr.q91: Would you rather know for certain you'll end up together but without passion, or have ten passionate years with no guarantee?
wyr.q92: Would you rather they chose you every morning, or chose you once and for all?
wyr.q93: Would you rather forgive without forgetting, or forget without forgiving?
wyr.q94: Would you rather people said you two were "inseparable", or "free"?
wyr.q95: Would you rather share everything except one thing, or share nothing except what really matters?
wyr.q96: Would you rather they knew your password, or read your diary?
wyr.q97: Would you rather you'd met ten years earlier, or ten years later?
wyr.q98: Would you rather get one perfect present a year, or ten terrible ones that were genuinely thought through?
wyr.q99: Would you rather they called you a ridiculous nickname in public, or by your surname in private?
wyr.q100: Would you rather keep one of their secrets your whole life, or finally tell them the one you've never told anyone?
